chunks: Till when matters come to a close, the world dies and resurrection draws near. Allāh would take them out from the corners of the graves, the nests of birds, the dens of beasts and the centres of death. They hasten towards His command and run towards the place fixed for their final return group by group, quiet, standing and arrayed in rows. They will be within Allāh’s sight and will hear every one who would call them. They would be having the dress of helplessness and covering of submission and indignity. (At this time) contrivances would disappear, desires would be cut, hearts would sink quietly, voices would be curbed down, sweat would choke the throat, fear would increase and ears would resound with the thundering voice of the announcer calling towards the final judgement, award of recompense, striking of punishment and paying of reward.
ai.seo_question: What happens during the Resurrection according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This passage from the 'Al-Gharra' chapter of Nahj al-Balagha vividly depicts the sudden emergence of humanity from diverse burial sites, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the physical reality of resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jismani). It highlights the universal state of humility and silence as individuals await the decisive judgment (fasl al-khitab), underscoring the transition from worldly deception to divine accountability.
